question: A person on anti-tubercular drugs complained of deafness and tinnitus in one ear. Drug implicated is?
analysis: The symptoms of deafness and tinnitus are indicative of ototoxicity, which is a known side effect of aminoglycoside antibiotics. Among the anti-tubercular drugs listed, Streptomycin is an aminoglycoside and is well-documented to cause ototoxicity, including hearing loss and tinnitus. The other drugs listed (Isoniazid, Ethambutol, and Rifampicin) do not typically cause these auditory side effects.
